title: P15.9-A1 R2: canonical KPI/budget re-proof in company, classified terminal-grant degrade, exact pending counts
description: R2 closure on PR #91 (BASE e24e334); R1 fixes preserved. R2-1: businessCompany now re-proves kpi.current + budget.consumed_microusd per objective via existing assertCanonicalObjectiveKpiProgress/assertCanonicalObjectiveBudget (same validators the operating loop runs) — forged claims (well-typed current/lek without evidence, consumed without spend events) fail the whole read closed; kpi_summary + budget carry canonically_proven flags; unproven KPI entries render assessment UNVERIFIED with the raw claim visible but never MET. R2-2: terminal-objective observation degrade narrowed to the ONE classified case — FAIL_CLOSED_P15_5_ADAPTIVE_REVIEW with 'authorization not effective (OBJECTIVE_TERMINAL)' (delegated verifier grant legitimately ended with the terminal objective). Tamper, forged progress, or any unclassified failure still throws (fail closed) on terminal and live objectives alike; unclassified errors never produce a degraded render that could display unproven MET. R2-3: businessCompany strict-reads ALL owned objectives (not just the 200-row display page) and computes targets_met_pending + objectives_owned over the full set — pending objectives beyond the display cap are counted exactly; objectives_returned reports the page size. Tests 23/23: adversarial forged kpi/budget on live (fail closed) and terminal objectives (unverifiable render for classified grant-end; fail closed for unclassified forge), proven claims still render MET, >200 pending counted exactly, all R1 negatives preserved. No CEO/Router/Executor/KPI-writer/Telegram changes; no auth expansion; no UI/A2. No merge/deploy.
